## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `WebRiskServiceClient`: Web Risk API defines an interface to detect malicious URLs on your website and in client applications.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `WebRiskServiceClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudWebRiskV1
import GoogleLongRunning

func sample() async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudWebRiskV1.WebRiskServiceClient()
  let response = try await client.computeThreatListDiff(
    request: ComputeThreatListDiffRequest()
  /* set fields using .with { $0... } */
)
  print("Success: \(response)")
}
```

## Requirements

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-webrisk-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-webrisk-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudWebRiskV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudWebRiskV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-webrisk-v1
```
